answer: Run synchronized liveness checks: at random moments the network sends every agent a pulse challenge that must be answered within seconds using a key sealed in its own hardware forge, an attested enclave that can't be cloned. One operator faking k identities must answer k simultaneous pulses on k separate enclaves, and identities whose responses share timing jitter are layered into a shale of suspects whose stakes rise with each layer, so cost grows faster than k.
